scope.evidence_basis: Actual original-source comparison and local derivation reread: Computed the interval bound |I|^(1-1/p)M and checked that compact X->B followed by continuous B->Y gives the spatial input for Simon in Y. In the contradiction proof, normalize by nonzero X norm: compactness gives a B limit, bounded B norms force Y norms to zero, and injectivity contradicts the B lower bound. The upgrade first chooses eta<epsilon/(4M), then the Cauchy index. For p=infinity, a full-measure dense set with X norm<=M and the same two-point estimate gives uniform B continuity and a unique extension agreeing in Y. This fills the representative detail without changing the principal.
